verdict_reason: Removing the obsolete matcher tests is right, but a module constant is now used by one test and the isSearchable title over-claims what it asserts.

todos.issue: BOS_TAURUS sits at module scope but, after this PR deleted the matchesWords tests, only one test reads it (normaliseQuery, line 9).
todos.fix: Must: the 'Bos taurus' literal lives in the one test that uses it. One way: write expect(normaliseQuery('  Bos taurus ')).toBe('Bos taurus') and delete the module constant.

todos.issue: The title 'Should hold results back until three characters are entered' claims results are withheld, but the assertions only prove isSearchable returns false for 'Bo' and '  Bo  ' and true for 'Bos' (plus the constant's value); nothing here checks results. Whether results are held back is proved, if anywhere, in search.controller.test.js.
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertions prove: a query counts as searchable only once it has three characters after trimming. One way: retitle to 'Should treat a query as searchable only from three trimmed characters'.
